quiz.explanation: vielerlei: many kinds of, all sorts of.

goodToKnow: Vielerlei means many kinds of or all sorts of, and it never changes its ending: vielerlei Gründe, auf vielerlei Weise, in vielerlei Hinsicht (in many respects). The -erlei suffix also gives allerlei (all sorts of), zweierlei (two kinds of: Das sind zweierlei Dinge, that's two different things), mancherlei and keinerlei (no ... whatsoever): keinerlei Probleme. Also used as a noun: Allerlei, a mixture, as in Leipziger Allerlei (mixed vegetables).
